title: Day 23: Marketing Beyond the MLS – Photos, Video & Reach
excerpt: Ninety-seven percent of buyers start online.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “real estate photography Austin”, “how to market my home for sale”, and “video tours Austin real estate” want a local, practical answer.

Ninety-seven percent of buyers start online. Professional photography, twilight shots, floor plans, and short video walk-throughs measurably increase showing traffic.

Social media targeting, email campaigns to buyer agents, and neighborhood-specific outreach expand the pool beyond passive MLS searchers.

Sellers should review the marketing plan before listing and request examples of recent campaigns in similar price ranges.

If you are weighing a list date, a price, or a repair list, The Banks Group will run the numbers for your street and help you decide. Start with a complimentary conversation.
